An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of CaSA. The issue results from the lack of proper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root.

ZDI-23-058.additional_details: Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/acrobat/apsb23-01.html
ZDI-23-058.search_text: published ZDI-23-058 ZDI-CAN-18293 Adobe Acrobat Reader DC Font Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-01-18 CVE-2023-21579 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-21579 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Adobe'] ['Acrobat Reader DC'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Adobe Acrobat Reader DC. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of embedded fonts. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer overflow before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process. Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/acrobat/apsb23-01.html ['2022-09-21 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-01-18 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] 0x1byte https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-058/
ZDI-23-058.title: Adobe Acrobat Reader DC Font Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
ZDI-23-058.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Adobe Acrobat Reader DC. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of embedded fonts. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer overflow before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-059.additional_details: Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/acrobat/apsb23-01.html

ZDI-23-1010.search_text: published ZDI-23-1010 ZDI-CAN-20525 Adtran SR400ac ping Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-07-28 CVE-2023-38120 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-38120 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Adtran'] ['SR400ac'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Adtran SR400ac routers. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. ZDI-23-1037.search_text: published ZDI-23-1037 ZDI-CAN-18905 VBASE VISAM Automation Base VBASE-Editor WebRemote File Parsing XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2023-08-08 CVE-2022-46286 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-46286 5.5 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['VBASE'] ['VISAM Automation Base'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of VBASE VISAM Automation Base. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of WebRemote.XML in the VBASE-Editor application. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the current process. VBASE has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. Furthermore, exploitation is possible only in limited circumstances. The specific flaw exists within the processing of unhandled exceptions. By redirecting a DOS device, an attacker can abuse a high-privileged service to launch an arbitrary executable. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of a high-privileged service account. Microsoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-35359 ['2023-08-03 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-08-15 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Le Qi Chen https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-1112/

ZDI-23-1113.search_text: published ZDI-23-1113 ZDI-CAN-17204 Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert VXDZ File Parsing Code Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-08-15 CVE-2023-1049 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-1049 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Schneider Electric'] ['EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert. The specific flaw exists within the processing of of VXDZ files while in simulation mode. ZDI-23-1113.title: Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert VXDZ File Parsing Code Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
ZDI-23-1113.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the processing of of VXDZ files while in simulation mode. When parsing name:value pairs in configuation data, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before executing it as code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of OXPS files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the copyContent command. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of SYSTEM.

ZDI-23-124.search_text: published ZDI-23-124 ZDI-CAN-19138 Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK DXF File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-02-09 CVE-2023-22670 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-22670 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Open Design Alliance (ODA)'] ['Drawing SDK'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DXF files. ZDI-23-124.title: Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK DXF File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
ZDI-23-124.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DXF files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. D-Link has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://supportannouncement.us.dlink.com/announcement/publication.aspx?name=SAP10349 ['2023-01-20 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-08-25 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Dmitry "InfoSecDJ" Janushkevich of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-1248/

ZDI-23-125.search_text: published ZDI-23-125 ZDI-CAN-19142 Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK DWG File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-02-09 CVE-2021-43336 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-43336 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Open Design Alliance (ODA)'] ['Drawing SDK'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DWG files. Crafted data in a DWG file can trigger a write past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. https://www.opendesign.com/security-advisories ['2022-10-20 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-02-09 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Mat Powell & Jimmy Calderon (@vectors2final) of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-125/
ZDI-23-125.title: Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK DWG File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
ZDI-23-125.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DWG files. Crafted data in a DWG file can trigger a write past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-126.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DXF files. Crafted data in a DXF file can trigger a write past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.

ZDI-23-130.search_text: published ZDI-23-130 ZDI-CAN-19148 Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK DGN File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-02-09 CVE-2021-32946 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-32946 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Open Design Alliance (ODA)'] ['Drawing SDK'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DGN files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. https://www.opendesign.com/security-advisories ['2022-10-18 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-02-09 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Mat Powell & Jimmy Calderon (@vectors2final) of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-130/
ZDI-23-130.title: Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK DGN File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
ZDI-23-130.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Open Design Alliance (ODA) Drawing SDK. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DGN files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of U3D files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. PDF-XChange has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. ZDI-23-1371.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PDF-XChange Editor. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of PDF files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the smtp service, which listens on TCP port 25 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account.

An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. Additionally, the target system must have multiple active monitors. The specific flaw exists within the IsSurfaceLockable function in the win32kfull driver. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a type confusion condition. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.

ZDI-23-1558.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation. The process loads an OpenSSL configuration file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.

An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. ZDI-23-1636.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR CAX30 routers. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-1663.additional_details: Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/audition/apsb23-64.html

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of embedded fonts. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-174.additional_details: Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://success.trendmicro.com/solution/000292209
ZDI-23-174.search_text: published ZDI-23-174 ZDI-CAN-18228 Trend Micro Apex One Security Agent Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2023-02-24 CVE-2023-25145 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-25145 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Trend Micro'] ['Apex One'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Trend Micro Apex One Security Agent. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the NT Apex One RealTime Scan Service. By creating a mount point, an attacker can abuse the service to delete a folder. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Extreme Networks has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://extreme-networks.my.site.com/ExtrArticleDetail?an=000115355&q=CVE-2023-46272 ['2023-07-06 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-12-12 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Victorien Molle - Biche Télécom https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-1765/

The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of Doc objects. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-187.additional_details: Siemens has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://cert-portal.siemens.com/productcert/html/ssa-847261.html

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Fixed in Archer AX21 version V3230219 https://www.tp-link.com/us/support/download/archer-ax21/#Firmware ['2023-01-11 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-03-15 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Reported by Xiaobye, working with DEVCORE Internship Program https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-245/

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of USD files. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-288.additional_details: Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/dimension/apsb23-20.html
ZDI-23-288.credit: Mat Powell of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of USD files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of USD files. Crafted data in a USD file can trigger a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-317.additional_details: Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/dimension/apsb23-20.html

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-331.additional_details: Siemens has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://cert-portal.siemens.com/productcert/pdf/ssa-847261.pdf

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of USD files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-406.additional_details: Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/substance3d_designer/apsb23-28.html
ZDI-23-406.credit: Mat Powell of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of Doc objects. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-434.additional_details: Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/acrobat/apsb23-24.html

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the SMB directory query command. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.

ZDI-23-448.additional_details: Sonos users with the S2 app installed should ensure their system is running software version 15.1 or later. Sonos users with the S1 app installed should be running version 11.7.1 or later. Users can check which software version they are running in the Sonos app > Settings > System > About My System. https://support.sonos.com/en-us/article/release-notes-for-sonos-s2
ZDI-23-448.credit: Phan Thanh Duy (@PTDuy) & Nguyen Hoang Thach (@hi_im_d4rkn3ss) of STAR Labs SG Pte. Ltd.

An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Sonos users with the S2 app installed should ensure their system is running software version 15.1 or later. Sonos users with the S1 app installed should be running version 11.7.1 or later. ZDI-23-528.search_text: published ZDI-23-528 ZDI-CAN-18414 D-Link DAP-1360 webproc var:menu Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-05-04 CVE-2023-32136 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-32136 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['D-Link'] ['DAP-1360'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1360 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling requests to the /cgi-bin/webproc endpoint. When parsing the var:menu parameter, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. D-Link has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. ZDI-23-547.additional_details: 01/26/22 – ZDI reported the vulnerability to the vendor. 02/02/22 – The vendor acknowledged the report. 08/24/22 – ZDI asked for an update. 08/24/22 – The vendor asked for additional details about the vulnerability. 09/19/22 – The vendor states that there is a patch, but the ZDI informed the vendor that the bug is still triggerable on the latest mainline. 10/05/22 – ZDI provided additional details. 10/07/22 – The vendor states there is a new patch, but the ZDI was able to reproduce the vulnerability on the latest mainline. 10/26/22 – The vendor informed the ZDI that they would continue to investigate. 04/12/23 – ZDI asked for an update. 04/14/23 – The vendor informed the ZDI that a new patch would merge into the latest mainline on 04/21/2023. 04/21/23 – The original finder reports to the vendor that the patch may not work, and it was confirmed by the ZDI that the vulnerability is reproducible on the latest mainline. 05/02/23 – The ZDI informed the vendor that the case will be published as a zero-day advisory on 05/04/23, and in coordination with Red Hat this vulnerability will be assigned CVE-2023-2156. -- Mitigation: Given the nature of the vulnerability, the only salient mitigation strategy is to restrict interaction with the application.

ZDI-23-586.search_text: published ZDI-23-586 ZDI-CAN-20182 Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprises widgetforsecurity set_certificates_config Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability 2023-05-12 CVE-2023-32526 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-32526 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N ['Trend Micro'] ['Mobile Security for Enterprises'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create arbitrary files on affected installations of Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprises. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the set_certificates_config action defined within the web/widgetforsecurity path. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of IUSR. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. ZDI-23-625.search_text: published ZDI-23-625 ZDI-CAN-20555 D-Link DIR-2150 SetSysEmailSettings AccountName Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-05-15 CVE-2023-34277 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-34277 6.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['D-Link'] ['DIR-2150'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2150 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the SOAP API interface, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. ZDI-23-634.search_text: published ZDI-23-634 ZDI-CAN-15484 Omron CX-One CX-Programmer CXP File Parsing Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-05-17 CVE-2022-43509 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-43509 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Omron'] ['CX-One'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Omron CX-One. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of CXP files in the CX-Programmer module. ZDI-23-722.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Microsoft Windows Active Directory Certificate Services. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the issuance of certificates. By including crafted data in a certificate request, an attacker can obtain a certificate that allows the attacker to authenticate to a domain controller with a high level of privilege. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the InstantPlaysDeepLink class. The issue results from a permissive list of allowed inputs. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.

ZDI-23-775.search_text: published ZDI-23-775 ZDI-CAN-20494 (Pwn2Own) Unified Automation UaGateway OPC UA Server Improper Input Validation Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2023-05-31 CVE-2023-32170 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-32170 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Unified Automation'] ['UaGateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Unified Automation UaGateway. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must choose to accept a client certificate. The specific flaw exists within the processing of client certificates. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of certificate data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Unified Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. ZDI-23-775.title: (Pwn2Own) Unified Automation UaGateway OPC UA Server Improper Input Validation Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
ZDI-23-775.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Unified Automation UaGateway. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must choose to accept a client certificate. The specific flaw exists within the processing of client certificates. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of certificate data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.

ZDI-23-776.additional_details: Unified Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://documentation.unified-automation.com/uagateway/1.5.14/CHANGELOG.txt
ZDI-23-776.search_text: published ZDI-23-776 ZDI-CAN-20495 (Pwn2Own) Unified Automation UaGateway OPC UA Server Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2023-05-31 CVE-2023-32171 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-32171 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Unified Automation'] ['UaGateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Unified Automation UaGateway. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ImportCsv method. A crafted XML payload can cause a null pointer dereference. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Unified Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://documentation.unified-automation.com/uagateway/1.5.14/CHANGELOG.txt ['2023-02-22 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-05-31 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Axel '0vercl0k' Souchet of https://doar-e.github.io/ https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-776/

ZDI-23-776.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Unified Automation UaGateway. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ImportCsv method. A crafted XML payload can cause a null pointer dereference. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.

ZDI-23-777.additional_details: Unified Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://documentation.unified-automation.com/uagateway/1.5.14/CHANGELOG.txt

ZDI-23-777.search_text: published ZDI-23-777 ZDI-CAN-20497 (Pwn2Own) Unified Automation UaGateway OPC UA Server Use-After-Free Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2023-05-31 CVE-2023-32172 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-32172 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Unified Automation'] ['UaGateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Unified Automation UaGateway. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the ImportXML function. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Unified Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://documentation.unified-automation.com/uagateway/1.5.14/CHANGELOG.txt ['2023-02-24 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-05-31 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Claroty Research - Team82 - Uri Katz, Noam Moshe, Vera Mens, Sharon Brizinov https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-777/
ZDI-23-777.title: (Pwn2Own) Unified Automation UaGateway OPC UA Server Use-After-Free Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
ZDI-23-777.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Unified Automation UaGateway. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the ImportXML function. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.

ZDI-23-778.additional_details: Prosys OPC has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://www.prosysopc.com/blog/pwn2own-2023-resource-exhaustion-exploit/

ZDI-23-778.search_text: published ZDI-23-778 ZDI-CAN-20544 (Pwn2Own) Prosys OPC UA Simulation Server OpenSecureChannel Resource Exhaustion Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2023-05-31 CVE-2023-32787 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-32787 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Prosys OPC'] ['UA Simulation Server'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Prosys OPC UA Simulation Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of OpenSecureChannel messages. By sending a large number of requests, an attacker can consume all available resources on the server. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Prosys OPC has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://www.prosysopc.com/blog/pwn2own-2023-resource-exhaustion-exploit/ ['2023-02-22 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-05-31 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Claroty Research - Team82 - Uri Katz, Noam Moshe, Vera Mens, Sharon Brizinov https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-778/
ZDI-23-778.title: (Pwn2Own) Prosys OPC UA Simulation Server OpenSecureChannel Resource Exhaustion Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
ZDI-23-778.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Prosys OPC UA Simulation Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of OpenSecureChannel messages. By sending a large number of requests, an attacker can consume all available resources on the server. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.

ZDI-23-779.additional_details: Unified Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://documentation.unified-automation.com/uagateway/1.5.14/CHANGELOG.txt
ZDI-23-779.search_text: published ZDI-23-779 ZDI-CAN-20576 Unified Automation UaGateway AddServer XML Injection Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2023-05-31 CVE-2023-32173 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-32173 5.8 AV:N/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Unified Automation'] ['UaGateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Unified Automation UaGateway. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability when the product is in its default configuration. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the AddServer method. By specifying crafted arguments, an attacker can cause invalid characters to be inserted into an XML configuration file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a persistent denial-of-service condition on the system. Unified Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://documentation.unified-automation.com/uagateway/1.5.14/CHANGELOG.txt ['2023-04-28 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-05-31 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Axel '0vercl0k' Souchet of https://doar-e.github.io/ https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-779/

ZDI-23-781.search_text: published ZDI-23-781 ZDI-CAN-19205 Delta Electronics CNCSoft-B DOPSoft DPA File Parsing Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-06-01 CVE-2023-25177 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-25177 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Delta Electronics'] ['CNCSoft-B'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Electronics CNCSoft-B. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DPA files by the DOPSoft executable. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Delta Electronics has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of DPA files by the DOPSoft component. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.

ZDI-23-801.additional_details: Delta Electronics has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/ics-advisories/icsa-23-157-01

ZDI-23-843.title: (Pwn2Own) Samsung Galaxy S22 McsWebViewActivity Permissive List of Allowed Inputs Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
ZDI-23-843.vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Samsung Galaxy S22 smartphones. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the McsWebViewActivity class. The issue results from a permissive list of allowed inputs. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the update functionality, which operates over HTTPS. ZDI-23-907.search_text: published ZDI-23-907 ZDI-CAN-19432 Siemens Solid Edge Viewer DWG File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2023-07-10 CVE-2023-26495 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-26495 3.3 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N ['Siemens'] ['Solid Edge Viewer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Siemens Solid Edge Viewer.
